description: Arpa Piemonte - localizzazione degli impianti di digestione anaerobica (biogas) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis.arpa.piemonte.it. Localization of anaerobic digestion plants, with particular attention to the livestock and agricultural sector. The plants have been divided into plants in operation, under construction and under authorization. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Arpa Piemonte - location of anaerobic digestion plants (biogas)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Piemonte, rinnovabili, biogas, Italia, aziende, RNDT. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
